text:
maria: I opened a docs PR to clarify async batching behavior in the model cards and to add a compact v3->v4 SDK migration snippet. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/7630
ajay: Which files were updated?
maria: model-catalog/limits.md (batching anchors + seq table), model-cards/nebula3b.md (compatibility row), model-cards/polaris13b.md (benchmarks), examples/sdk-migration.md (v3 -> v4 side-by-side snippets). Branch: docs/batch-migrate-7630.
sasha: Dropping bench notes for context:
polaris13b fp16 | batch_window=20ms | batch=4 => p50 ~45ms, p99 ~120ms
nebula3b q4_0  | cold start +80ms, steady ~40ms
Note: larger batch_window helps high QPS but hurts low-QPS tail.
olivia: The SDK snippet still used client.call() 9 style. We should show client.generate() for v4 and explicitly state batch_window units are milliseconds now. I'll update the snippets.
ben: Also change exact token counts in examples to approximate values like "~42 tokens" to avoid implying determinism.
docbot: lint: missing anchor for `batch_window` cross-ref in model-catalog/limits.md  see docs-lint CI failure.
maria: Added the anchor and compatibility rows (CPU fallback: yes/no; quantized determinism: low/med/high) to Nebula and Polaris. Pushed updates.
ajay: Quick review request: state that batch_window is a client-side hint and routing policies or Dedicated autoscaler may adjust effective behavior.
maria: Added one-line clarification in the migration guide.
docbot: CI passed (lint + linkcheck).
deploy-bot: docs-site build started (sha: e7f6c2d)
deploy-bot: docs-site build SUCCEEDED  https://docs.redwood.ai/changes/7630
maria: Merged. If anyone finds broken SDK examples after the change, ping me and I'll open a follow-up.
ben: Follow-up: can we add a short heuristics table for recommended batch_window for low/medium/high QPS?
maria: Good call, I'll open a follow-up PR to sketch that table.
